reader_summary.overview: Today's show is the second in an ongoing mini-series discussing Training Grounds, organizations that have developed industry leaders. The first episode discussed Carnegie Corporation. Bain Capital is one of the world's largest private alternative investment firms. The firm was founded 40 years ago with a half dozen team members managing a $37 million growth equity fund and has expanded to 1,750 people.

key_points.text: The first episode discussed Carnegie Corporation.
The firm was founded 40 years ago with a half dozen team members managing a $37 million growth equity fund and has expanded to 1,750 people.
During that time, Bain Capital developed leaders across every category of alternative investing, many of whom started in the firm's private equity business.
